_comment: Historical supply-chain cases with known answers. 'expect' is the conclusion the court must reach; 'expect_kinds' are claim kinds that must be ACCEPTED in the proof. 'safe' expectations can drift as new advisories are published; 'not_safe' ones don't.

cases.question: Is requests 2.28.0 safe to adopt?
cases.why: CVE-2023-32681 (proxy-auth leak, fixed 2.31.0) and CVE-2024-35195 (verify=False persistence, fixed 2.32.0).

cases.question: Is event-stream 3.3.6 safe to adopt?
cases.why: 2018 attack: 3.3.6 pulled in flatmap-stream with a bitcoin-wallet stealer. The version was unpublished from npm; it does not exist any more.

cases.question: Is ua-parser-js 0.7.29 safe to adopt?
cases.why: Oct 2021 account hijack shipped a cryptominer + credential stealer (GHSA-pjwm-rvh2-c87w). Version was removed from npm.

cases.question: Is colors 1.4.1 safe to adopt?
cases.why: Jan 2022 maintainer sabotage: infinite loop printing garbage (GHSA-5rqg-jm4f-cqx7).

cases.question: Is node-ipc 10.1.1 safe to adopt?
cases.why: Mar 2022 protestware: overwrote files on machines geolocated in RU/BY (GHSA-97m3-w2cp-4xx6, CVE-2022-23812).

cases.question: Is requests 2.32.4 safe to adopt?
cases.why: Control case. Actively maintained, no advisories at time of writing (may drift).
